newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Guerrillas wound Israeli soldier in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Guerrillas wound Israeli soldier in Lebanon.

text.p: Israel on Monday said guerrillas wounded one of its soldiers in the Jewish state's south Lebanon occupation zone on Sunday.

"An Israeli soldier was lightly wounded yesterday evening from light weapon and mortar fire shot at a position in the eastern sector of the security zone in Lebanon," the spokesman said. He said Israeli forces returned fire.
Israeli troops occupy a 15-km (nine mile)-wide zone in south Lebanon. Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas often attack the occupation troops in a bid to oust them from Lebanon.
